items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 1.4% in 1985 to 3.5% in 2025 across 68 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

4 of 68 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 9 for salt or chloride; 6 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 68 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 5 of 5 high-need ones have none.
